confidence_notes: Phu Quoc item-level data is sparse. Meal prices have recent local-guide support, but coffee and drink evidence is thinner; cocktail and wine prices are estimated from their usual premium over local beer. Lodging figures are holistic estimates, not live listing prices.
comparable_city_reasoning: Used Vietnam island-resort pricing with Duong Dong local food as the low-cost baseline and a tourism premium for mid-range meals and drinks.
